test_GTestUninitializedTest: test the GTestUninitializedTest class to verify Google Test warns when not initialized properly
run_TestExitCodeAndOutput: run TestExitCodeAndOutput with a command to verify its exit code and output contains InitGoogleTest
assert_Assert: assert a condition using the Assert function that raises AssertionError if the condition is false
